blocks: fit plus/minus hands and charges r1/r2 separately; never pool their spectra
covariance: one full batch covariance per independent radius block; exact/singular modes removed only by a fixed relative eigenvalue cutoff 1e-10
primary: minimum block-whitened squared distance to the known-support nonnegative Fourier cone

calibration.method: plug-in Gaussian bootstrap in every resolved whitened block, refitting the nonnegative cone

controls: unconstrained 101-frequency WLS residual is reported only as a fit floor
exact displacement aliases must share Fourier design rows
zero-variance identities are not regularized into evidence
no active frequency or fitted spectrum is interpreted as unique when the cone completion is nonidentifiable
claim_boundary: Passing supports the finite-group spatial-autocorrelation representation, not an eight-state physical transfer or a CFT field count.
Failure would diagnose acquisition/gauge/stationarity/covariance incompatibility before physical interpretation.
The four hand/charge scores are correlated views of archived streams, not four independent votes.
